The servants would sometimes talk about seeing things during their night patrols. So, during my normal, everyday life, I would completely forget about the name "Beatrice". Of course, when that huge portrait was first hung, it definitely felt creepy. We gradually got used to it, and eventually bored of it. I didn't really care anymore about the portrait of the mistress from Grandfather's delusions.
